name: Maya alive vs Heller belief
rule: Maya is not actually dead at setup, although protagonist believes it.

name: Mercer protagonist to antagonist
rule: Sequel role shift is observed; why character changed must not be retroactively invented as a fact. Developer acknowledges editorial choice, not complete in-world causal proof.

name: Original prototype identity
rule: Virus/body/memory distinction from Prototype 2009 applies; memory transfer does not establish continuous identity.

name: Whitelight proof status
rule: Publisher marketing does not cover Whitelight specifics; gameplay guide and tertiary summary evidence must remain lower confidence.

name: Supplemental DLC and comics
rule: No events from graphic-novel/comic tie-ins or DLC promoted to main game unless separately cited and tagged; all such material out of scope.

name: Gameplay agency vs authored story
rule: Player killing and ambient open-world violence not proof of narrative reputation system or automatic ethical feedback.
